## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the preview’s containment check before merge because it allows reads outside the selected home directory.

## Changes

The pull request adds a 200-character file preview, a helper for the `settings.toml` path, and tests for both helpers.

## Critical

- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Check containment after resolving paths — A relative path with a parent-directory component or an in-home symlink pointing outside can return text from outside the selected home. `is_relative_to()` checks the unresolved path, while `read_text()` follows the filesystem target. — A caller who controls the preview path can read the first 200 characters of an outside text file the process can access. — Fix: Resolve the home and candidate before checking containment, then open the resolved candidate.

## Important

- app/paths.py:14 — correctness — Bound the preview read to 200 characters — Previewing a multi-gigabyte text log can fail on a memory-constrained process because `read_text()` loads the entire file before the slice runs. — Users can lose access to a short preview when opening a large log. — Fix: Open the file with a context manager and call `read(200)` on the text stream.
